direction.situation: Beside his small food three-wheeler on a rainy Colombo roadside, Kasun answers Anudi's interest in how he manages the business. Her curiosity gives him room to share his ambition without showing off.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right facing Anudi offscreen left, wearing a plain faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. His hands rest empty at his sides; he feels quietly proud and increasingly at ease.

flow.text: Kasun keeps his eyes on Anudi to the left. He takes a small breath and lifts his chin slightly, gathering his answer without display.

flow.how: Friendly and matter-of-fact at first, wanting her to understand his independent start; quiet pride opens into hope toward the end, with a restrained smile forming as he maintains direct eye contact

flow.text: His lips settle and he lets the account stand without seeking approval. His eyes stay on Anudi, the small smile lingering.

direction.camera: A locked-off, eye-level medium close-up from the road side on a 65mm lens holds Kasun frame right, with the food three-wheeler softly behind his shoulder in the right background, in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant road traffic beneath his natural conversational voice; no music.
